== The Iron Gate ==


-- Story Background --

A locked estate holds secrets its last owner took to the grave.


-- Character --

Name
----
Petra Voss

Background
----------
A sharp-tongued archivist who never met a locked door she couldn't open — eventually.

Skills
------
Research: 4 (Highly skilled)
Lockpicking: 3 (Competent)
Charisma: 2 (Unskilled)

Starting Tracked Items
----------------------
Gold Coins:
10

Notes:


-- Turn 1 --

Outcome
-------
You push open the gate and step inside.

- - - - -

Your objective: Find the missing will before the estate goes to auction.

- - - - -

Secret Information
------------------
The will is hidden behind the third painting in the east wing.

Tracked Items
-------------
Gold Coins:
10

Notes:

Hidden Tracked Items
--------------------
Estate Lock State:
unlocked

-- Turn 2 --

Action
------
Search the entrance hall for clues.

Outcome
-------
You find a torn scrap of paper with a room number.

Secret Information
------------------
The paper was planted by a rival.

Tracked Items
-------------
Gold Coins:
10

Notes:
Scrap of paper found.

Hidden Tracked Items
--------------------
Estate Lock State:
unlocked

-- Turn 3 --

Action
------
Go to the east wing.

Outcome
-------
The east wing is dark and smells of old paper. Three paintings hang on the far wall.

Secret Information
------------------
The rival is watching from the shadows.

Tracked Items
-------------
Gold Coins:
8

Notes:
Scrap of paper found.
Bought a candle from a vendor outside.

Hidden Tracked Items
--------------------
Estate Lock State:
relocked

-- Turn 4 --

Action
------
Examine the third painting.

Outcome
-------
Behind it: an envelope sealed with red wax.

Secret Information
------------------
The envelope contains both the will and a second letter implicating the rival.

Tracked Items
-------------
Gold Coins:
8

Notes:
Scrap of paper found.
Bought a candle from a vendor outside.

Hidden Tracked Items
--------------------
Estate Lock State:
relocked

-- Turn 5 --

Action
------
Open the envelope.

Outcome
-------
The will names you as the sole heir. The estate is yours.

Secret Information
------------------
The rival has fled. Case closed.

Tracked Items
-------------
Gold Coins:
8

Notes:
Scrap of paper found.
Bought a candle from a vendor outside.

Hidden Tracked Items
--------------------
Estate Lock State:
relocked
